Rise and Shine Day Traders!!!
TLP C is making waves! #1 Queried Company On BoardCentral This Morning. Get
Your Bids In Pronto.

Today: Oct 22
Company: Telpac Industries
Stock: TLP C
Closed Price: 0.32
Target: $3.50

TLP C has selected established mobile game developers Revolution Games, Inc
to write two sports games that will focus on graphics intense, multi player
gaming. Instead of charging gamers a flat price up front, TLP C is using the
micro payment payment model pioneered by heavyweights like Zynga. Micro
Payments promote gamers to buy in-game upgrades to secure an upper hand over
other gamers. Both games will be released in Q4 for the 100 million users on
the Android Market and Apple App Store.
